_comment: Master crop config. Edit values here to tune gameplay. Add new crops by appending; old ones cannot be removed without breaking saves.

qingcai.story_zh: 上海青又叫小白菜，叶子翠绿，茎部白嫩，是炒饭和清炒的好搭档。东方超市每周到货 3 次，新鲜程度看叶尖。
qingcai.story_en: Also called baby bok choy. Tender white stems, deep green leaves — perfect for stir-fries. Eastern Market gets a fresh batch three times a week.
qingcai.recipe_zh: 蒜蓉上海青：上海青 + 蒜末 + 几滴生抽，热油下锅 90 秒搞定。
qingcai.recipe_en: Garlic bok choy: bok choy + minced garlic + dash of soy sauce, 90 seconds in a hot wok.

tomato.story_zh: 番茄是少有的能生吃的「菜」。挑番茄要看蒂的绿不绿——绿的新鲜。
tomato.story_en: Pick the ones with bright green stems — those are freshest. Eat raw or cooked.
tomato.recipe_zh: 番茄炒蛋：番茄切块 + 鸡蛋打散，先炒蛋再下番茄，5 分钟一道家常菜。
tomato.recipe_en: Tomato and egg stir-fry: scramble the egg first, add tomato chunks, done in 5 minutes.

cucumber.story_zh: 夏天最解暑。东方超市卖的是水黄瓜，皮薄汁多。
cucumber.story_en: Refreshing in summer. Eastern Market carries Asian cucumber — thinner skin, crunchier.
cucumber.recipe_zh: 拍黄瓜：拍碎 + 蒜末 + 醋 + 香油，凉拌 5 分钟。
cucumber.recipe_en: Smashed cucumber: bash with knife flat, garlic + vinegar + sesame oil, 5-min cold dish.

chili.story_zh: 川菜湘菜的灵魂。东方超市有线椒、二荆条、朝天椒，各有各的辣法。
chili.story_en: The soul of Sichuan and Hunan cooking. Eastern Market carries multiple varieties — pick by heat preference.
chili.recipe_zh: 虎皮青椒：青椒煎至起皮，淋蒜醋汁，下饭神器。
chili.recipe_en: Tiger-skin peppers: pan-fry until blistered, drizzle with garlic-vinegar sauce.

eggplant.story_zh: 长茄子和西方圆茄子不一样——更细长，皮薄籽少。
eggplant.story_en: Long, slender Asian eggplant — much milder than Western round eggplant. Less bitter, no need to salt.
eggplant.recipe_zh: 鱼香茄子：长茄子切条，过油后下蒜末豆瓣酱，咸甜微辣。
eggplant.recipe_en: Yuxiang eggplant: cut into strips, fry briefly, then sauce with garlic and doubanjiang.

jiucai.story_zh: 韭菜越割越旺，所以又叫「起阳草」。这游戏里也是——种一次能割三次。
jiucai.story_en: Chinese chives grow back after cutting. Plant once, harvest three times.
jiucai.recipe_zh: 韭菜炒蛋 / 韭菜盒子 / 包饺子，万能配菜。
jiucai.recipe_en: Stir-fry with eggs, fill dumplings, or make chive pockets. Endless uses.

garlic.story_zh: 中餐的灵魂。东方超市常年备货，独头蒜更辛辣。
garlic.story_en: Soul of Chinese cooking. Single-clove garlic is more pungent than regular.
garlic.recipe_zh: 蒜蓉酱：剁碎 + 热油泼 + 一勺生抽，配啥都香。
garlic.recipe_en: Garlic sauce: mince, sizzle in hot oil, add soy. Goes with everything.

cilantro.story_zh: 爱的人很爱，不爱的人「这是肥皂吧」。基因决定。
cilantro.story_en: You either love it or it tastes like soap to you. Genetic, actually.
cilantro.recipe_zh: 凉拌牛肉、火锅蘸料、葱姜蒜的最佳搭档。
cilantro.recipe_en: Garnish for cold beef, hotpot dip, soups. Trio-essential with scallion and ginger.

_festival_crops._comment: Only appear during festival windows. Not in main rotation.

narcissus.story_zh: 南方春节必备的水仙花，象征「凌波仙子」。东方超市春节前会到货水培装。
narcissus.story_en: A Lunar New Year flower especially in southern China. Eastern Market stocks bulbs before the festival.

kumquat.story_zh: 「桔」与「吉」同音。家家户户摆一盆年橘讨吉利。
kumquat.story_en: The Cantonese word for kumquat sounds like 'lucky'. Every household displays one at New Year.

taro.story_zh: 中秋拜月时供品。蒸熟后软糯，可甜可咸。
taro.story_en: An offering during Mid-Autumn moon-worship. Steamed, it's soft and sweet.

pomelo.story_zh: 中秋月圆，柚子也圆。吃完柚子皮还能做帽子。
pomelo.story_en: Round like the full moon. Kids wear the rind as hats — try it!

osmanthus.story_zh: 「八月桂花遍地开」。香气可入酒、入糕、入茶。
osmanthus.story_en: August osmanthus blossoms — can be infused into wine, cakes, and tea.
